get.description: Returns a list of all equipment timecard entries for the given date range. If no date/date range is provided, it returns entries for the current date.

parameters.description: The beginning of the date range for equipment timecard entries. (YYYY-MM-DD) Start date is inclusive.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end of the date range for equipment timecard entries. (YYYY-MM-DD) End date is inclusive.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: serializer_view
parameters.description: Optional response blueprint view. Defaults to `compact`.

parameters.description: Return item(s) matching the specified equipment identifier(s).

parameters.name: filters[timesheet_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) matching the specified timesheet ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[wbs_code_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) matching the specified WBS code ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[party_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) matching the specified party ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved
